page.overview:
Who is Bibs?

Bibs was a Bravaisian Jedi Padawan who lived during the High Republic Era. A member of the class of Padawans training aboard the Star Hopper, Bibs was, along with the rest of the class, dispatched to aid Trymant IV when it fell under threat from the Great Hyperspace Disaster.

Bibs first appeared in the first issue of the Star Wars: The High Republic Adventures comic series. The issue was written by Daniel José Older, illustrated by Harvey Tolibao, and released by IDW Publishing

Cole Horton's reference book Star Wars: The High Republic: Chronicles of the Jedi, uses "they/them" pronouns for Bibs. uses "he/him" pronouns in the character's entry. and first introduced Bibs into the Star Wars canon, The author noted that the character had been created with and used "he/him" in scripts until that point, but surmised that the inclusion of both in sources could meant that Bibs went by "he/they" pronouns in canon. Older then indicated that he felt the best way to think of the Bibs was to use "he/they" pronouns when referring to them.

Star Wars: The High Republic: Chronicles of the Jedi
